Messages.Author: Ira
Messages.Body:
> Can the controller of Jacob the Glitch play a Sudden Reversal to
> cancel the mastercard discarded as a master phase action?

I'm confident the answer is no.

> And can Babble be played by an untapped vampire in torpor
> to give someone else intercept?

I'm extremely confident the answer is no, because vampires can't play
reaction cards while in torpor (unless the card says otherwise.)
